name: acyclic-agent-workspaces
description: Transparent recursive subagent workspaces backed by the Acyclic distributed filesystem.

interface.shortDescription: Isolate and merge recursive Codex subagents.
interface.longDescription: Creates a real Acyclic filesystem workspace for every Codex subagent, redirects filesystem tools into it, and exposes only inspect, merge, and discard decisions to the parent.
defaultPrompt: Run subagents in isolated Acyclic workspaces.
